correctness.rationale: Geometric fixed points in an abstract simplicial complex support unions of complete g-orbits with uniform barycentric coefficients, giving a PL homeomorphism to an explicitly constructed orbit-clique complex L_g (NOT merely a fixed-vertex subcomplex). Original CHECKER.py was read: it constructs all 392 affine permutations, checks isometries, lists every eligible orbit and clique, performs elementary free-face collapses with unique immediate maximal coface tests and recognizes S0/S1/S2 terminal complexes by manifold links and Euler number. This is an exact finite algorithm for a fixed 49-point space. Independently constructed a separate orbit-compatibility clique enumerator and checked all 392 Euler characteristics against the claimed classification; got type counts S3=1, S2=14, S1=75, S0=182, empty=120. This Euler check does not alone prove homotopy; the finite collapse argument and audited program support the homotopy types, with complete source-run replay as residual reproducibility risk. Identity S3 case is imported from Adams et al. Section 7. Finite cyclic Lefschetz χ(Fix(g))=1−tr(g|H3) then gives ε1ε2 for both classes of automorphism, without claiming fixed loci of arbitrary subgroups.
residual_risks: Original full exhaustive CHECKER.py source and algorithm audited; independent reproduction reran Euler all 392 but not all asserted elementary collapse sequences, so strongest homotopy classification still depends on correctness of inspected finite collapse code.
Only elementwise cyclic fixed spaces, not all subgroups or full equivariant homotopy, are determined; other parameter grids excluded.
